description:
Hi! I'm Saakshi, an enthusiastic student innovator interested in AI/ML, space exploration, technology and creative problem-solving. I'm working on "Abandoned but Not Forgotten" and looking for curious, dedicated minds to build something meaningful together.

Seeking teammates skilled in Python, AI/ML, Data Science, GIS, Remote Sensing, Astronomy, Web Development, UI/UX or Research. Beginners with creativity, passion and a willingness to learn are equally welcome!

S² Voyagers 🚀
